project_name: Kreyszigg Softbizz Corporate Website & Integrated Admin Platform

client_specifications.styling_philosophy: Plain CSS Modules + CSS Custom Properties, Strict Architectural Editorial Grid, zero generic AI slop, no repetitive card clones, no heavy gloss, pure crisp craftsmanship with deep slate + warm ivory + muted copper accents.

entry_surfaces./: Asymmetric editorial split hero with bold typography and capability pillars left, structural architectural geometric graphic right on Warm Ivory (#F5F2EB) and Deep Slate (#17232F)
entry_surfaces./services/mobile-app-development: Deep Slate header badge leading into a high-density dual-column architectural blueprint layout with tech stack chips and sprint deliverables
entry_surfaces./hire-developers: Editorial taxonomy directory with sticky filter rail, multi-tier experience matrices, and transparent engagement model calculators
entry_surfaces./phobos: Executive command center with deep slate / crisp white dual-theme toggle, KPI metric slabs, Recharts pipeline charts, and full-fidelity leads management table

motion.transition_default: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 0.25s ease, background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease

accessibility.data_testids: All interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and filters must provide role-based kebab-case data-testid attributes.

images.description: Architectural geometric facade representing structured engineering and digital craftsmanship
Minimalist geometric shadow texture for Mobile App Development service detail hero card
Warm copper & slate abstract code depth for Hire Developers technical capability matrix

brand_logos.note: Use exact client provided assets at /brand/logo-primary.png and /brand/logo-mark.png. On dark footer, place logo inside a Warm Ivory (#F5F2EB) rounded-sm container to preserve original raster contrast.

public_navigation.features: Sticky on scroll, Warm Ivory / Deep Slate contrast, Mega menu dropdown for 11 services across 3 tiers, primary CTA 'Let\'s Discuss Your Project', accessible mobile sheet navigation drawer

public_footer.features: Deep Slate (#17232F) background, 4-column structured editorial layout (Company, Services, Hire Developers, Get in Touch), Warm Ivory logo badge container, newsletter input with validation, Back-to-Top smooth trigger, floating WhatsApp quick-action button

cookie_consent.features: Minimalist floating banner with granular preferences and localStorage state persistence

admin_shell.features: 14-item navigation sidebar, topbar with active page breadcrumb, unread notification counter bell, search trigger, and instant Light/Dark CSS-variable theme toggle

admin_dashboard_widgets.features: 5 KPI summary tiles, Recharts monthly enquiry trend line, lead status conversion bar chart, recent inbound inquiries table, upcoming client follow-ups

admin_leads_table.features: Rich filterable leads data table with search, status filter (New, Contacted, Qualified, Proposal Sent, Won, Lost), date range filter, export button, and lead detail drawer

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the client's 4-color palette: Deep Slate (#17232F), Warm Ivory (#F5F2EB), White (#FFFFFF), and Muted Copper (#A56F4E).
Use CSS Custom Properties and modular styling with pure CSS / CSS modules or utility classes adhering directly to these design tokens.

Never display fabricated client logos, fake team photos, or made-up statistics. If a section is empty (e.g. Testimonials, Featured Projects, Insights), display an elegant, clean empty state or factual capability statement.
Ensure the Admin section (/phobos) has completely distinct visual architecture from the public site, supporting both crisp Light and Deep Slate Dark themes via CSS data-theme attributes.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (navigation buttons, CTA links, tabs, filters, forms, theme toggles) for robust testing.
Ensure Ubuntu font is properly imported and applied across all heading and body styles.
